name: Marasmius oreades

ecology.season: late spring to autumn; all year where mild

notes: Grass is stimulated at the live edge of the ring with a dead zone behind, and fruit bodies revive after drying [22]. Europe and North America are sourced [22]; Asia and Australasia, and a genome sequenced from rings (Hiltunen 2019), are reported but unchecked.

tip_speed.note: ring radius grows about 10 to 30 cm/year (secondary and century-old sources); 20 cm/year taken as a year-round average, so the tip speed while active will be higher

uptake_rate.note: tuning value tied to tip speed
